message: Field "Post.title": @default("untitled") is not supported. MongoDB has no stored defaults, and Prisma 8 fills only `now()` on DateTime fields. The Prisma 6 client fills this default today, so removing it also changes the Prisma 6 app: every Prisma 6 create call must then pass "title". Set the value in the application code that creates documents, then remove the default.
